rules.text: Pick one: a second Advanced Nature Affinity release (set it on the sheet); a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu Expert stance's benefits while in Cross-Style; or the Genjutsu button.

Long rest ritual: weapons of one Weapon Group or Property you wield are Flame Blessed until your next long rest: you can't be disarmed of them unless incapacitated; their attacks can use your Taijutsu, Ninjutsu or Genjutsu modifier; a rank of Mastery to their [Weapon Damage] ([Unarmed Damage] with the Unarmed property).
Bonus action: enter the Cross-Style stance (the clan's stance item).

roll.note: Reaction, an ally within 10 feet takes an attack's damage: swap spaces; it hits you, less your [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] (roll it, reduce by hand).
Reaction, an ally within 10 feet would take damage: it takes half; you take the other half, same type.

rules.text: (Its copy of Blazing's Amp is removed, as King Q-E12.)
Creatures you choose starting their turn within 10 feet of you lose 1 rank of Demoralized and of Shaken.

roll.note: Action: allies you see within 20 feet who are Incapacitated, Stunned, Dying or Unconscious make a DC 20 Constitution save, +1 per Will spent (once per long rest per creature). At 0 hit points: spend all Hit Dice, regain the result, Exhaustion ranks equal to half the dice spent; with hit points: those conditions end and they stand up.

Once per turn, casting a jutsu as an Action: Will by its rank (D 1 ... S 5) casts a second jutsu of another discipline, same rank and casting time (neither concentration nor reduced cost), in the same action; no Bonus action jutsu until your next turn. Second jutsu: Ninjutsu −1 on saves for creatures with Physical, Elemental or Sensory ranks; Taijutsu: the first gains Combo, its damage pushes 10 feet; Bukijutsu: the first gains Chain, its damage gives −1 AC until your next turn; Genjutsu: swap places with a willing ally within half your speed.

rules.text: The Cross-Style stance, a Chakra, Taijutsu and Bukijutsu stance at once (its text is Cross-Style's, as King Q-E9): [Unarmed Damage] d6; [Unarmed] and [Weapon Damage] take your Advanced Nature Affinity release's type (Medical: poison; pick when you roll); Unified Form.

roll.note: A rank of Mastery to your next d20 roll (7th: 3 Will for two ranks; 15th: 5 Will for three).
Once per turn: an extra reaction, lost at the end of this turn (one per round). Each further use costs 1 more Will until a short rest (spend it by hand).
Once per turn: use your reaction to cast a jutsu or use a feature that costs 1 Action.
Start of a turn you make a Death save, before rolling: gain a success.
Another creature's d20 roll: a rank of Mastery (7th: 4 Will for two; 15th: 6 Will for three).
Reaction, you or an ally fails a save: remake it.
Casting a 1-Action jutsu: cast it again at a different creature in the same action, no chakra.
Bonus action, in combat, once per 10 minutes: hit or chakra points. Roll your Hit or chakra die by hand and add it; this is the Constitution modifier + 1d6 per Will after the first.
